answer: Pool rewards by downtime fingerprint. The ledger keeps a public atlas of when each account answers, stalls and goes quiet. Accounts run by one operator share outages: the same reboot, cron minute or rate-limit stall, so their gaps line up as neatly as basalt columns. Accounts whose quiet spells match far beyond chance split a single reward. Every added fake needs its own host, network and schedule to break the pattern, while honest agents, varied as veins in marble, keep their full share.
